platforms.name: GlimNavi (그림나비)
observedFacts: GlimNavi Studio (/function-step3.html) structures webtoon production into 5 explicit workflow stages: 01 기획 및 각색, 02 콘티, 03 선화, 04 채색(채색/자동 채색), 05 효과(AI 그림자, 조명효과, 명암효과).
Line-art extraction (AI 선따기) exposes 5 model versions via #lineartWorkflowSelect: v1.0 기본 선화, v2.0 원본 보존 선화, v2.1 정밀 선화, v2.2 학습 선화, v2.3 균형 선화.
Line-art expression presets (#lineartPresetSelect) expose 6 controls: 얇은 선, 얼굴 보존, 명암 유지, 빠른 변환, 깨끗한 선, 디테일 보존, plus 컬러 레이어 분리.
Canvas presets support 800×600, 1024×768, 1280×720, 1920×1080, 2560×1440 via custom DOM event relight:setBaseSize and export options downloadCanvas, downloadAllLayers, and downloadPSD.
inferences: Each of the 5 lineart versions maps to distinct backend ComfyUI/diffusion controlnet workflows behind https://www.glimnavi.com/backend.
unknowns: Server-side ComfyUI node graph weights and authenticated credit deduction rate per v2.2/v2.3 pass require an authenticated backend session.

platforms.name: Snaptoon & Snapboard (스냅툰 · 스냅보드)
observedFacts: Snaptoon unifies 3 products under the slogan '3D로 그리고, AI로 변환하고, 이야기로 완성합니다': Snaptoon (3D real-time rendering), Snapboard (AI creation/transformation workspace), and Snaptoon Warehouse (3D asset store).
Design system contrasts warm editorial paper (--bg-light: #FAF8F5) with deep studio dark (--bg-dark: #0A0A0A) and indigo accents (#1E3A5F).
inferences: Snapboard acts as the cloud AI img2img/controlnet bridge consuming camera passes exported from the desktop Snaptoon 3D renderer.
unknowns: Internal Snapboard workspace authenticated API endpoints and GPU queue parameters.

platforms.name: KAISTORY & KAITOON (카이스토리 · 카이툰)
observedFacts: KAISTORY links 4 dedicated webtoon production subdomains over one project data envelope: conti.kaistory.net (offline-first conti), design.kaistory.net (layered PSD, multilingual automation, speaker TTS), editor.kaistory.net (full-resolution export), and story.kaistory.net (reader distribution).
Using the same single-project data envelope, KAISTORY generates interactive learning cards and comprehension quizzes for KAION / KAITOON education services.
inferences: Balloon text, speaker metadata, and cut boundaries are stored as structured JSON alongside raster/PSD layers so translation, TTS, and quiz generation share one canonical source.
unknowns: Exact IndexedDB schema inside conti.kaistory.net requires authenticated subdomain session.

platforms.name: GGOOMING (꾸밍)
observedFacts: Next.js App Router application exposing routes /, /dashboard, /dashboard/projects, /dashboard/projects/new, /sign-in, /sign-up, /admin.
Focused on rapid social comic (Instatoon) creation, character style consistency, and brand collaboration project workflows.
inferences: Uses Clerk/Supabase-style session gating before mounting the project canvas under /dashboard/projects/new.

platforms.name: Plask Motion (플라스크)
observedFacts: Provides single-camera video-to-3D motion capture, VRM/FBX retargeting, keyframe smoothing, and camera/DOF/motion-blur passes for webtoon/animation.
inferences: Separates inferred pose streams from editable keyframe tracks to prevent foot sliding during camera angle changes.

platforms.name: ManhwaAI
observedFacts: Exposes routes /manhwa-character-generator, /manhwa-editor, /comic-editor, /editor, /characters, /gallery/manhwa, /tools, /pricing, and /api/editor/projects.

Ships 6 explicit style presets (/styles/black-and-white.webp, full-color.webp, grayscale.webp, monochrome.webp, sketch.webp, watercolor.webp) and 5 procedural manga/manhwa tone overlays (/tones/FocusingLine.png, SpeedLine.png, Tone.png, ToneNoise.png, ToneSnow.png).
inferences: Combines AI panel generation with deterministic overlay compositing for speed lines, focus lines, and screentones inside /manhwa-editor.

platforms.name: Komiko AI
observedFacts: Client bundle exposes specialized creator tools: /ai-agent, /ai-comic-generator, /ai-anime-generator, /oc-maker, /inbetween, /video_interpolation, /line_art_colorization, /sketch_simplification, /layer_splitter, /background-removal, /image-upscaling, and /voice/generate.
inferences: Positions OC Maker (/oc-maker) as the persistent character anchor across comic panels, line-art colorization, and inbetween animation.
unknowns: Exact credit cost per /layer_splitter and /inbetween invocation.

platforms.name: Anifusion
observedFacts: SvelteKit application with 22 routes including /dashboard/animator/, /dashboard/canvas/, /dashboard/character-sheets/, /dashboard/comic-presets/, /dashboard/flow/, /dashboard/models/, /dashboard/sketch/, /dashboard/templates/, /dashboard/training/, /dashboard/videos/, and /editor/.
Includes dedicated UI modules FlowImageSelector, UniversalPromptEditor, and prompt_rephrase_client.
inferences: Provides dual authoring modalities: node-graph generation (/dashboard/flow/) and spatial panel composition (/dashboard/canvas/ and /editor/).

platforms.name: Katalist AI
observedFacts: Specializes in script-to-storyboard parsing, consistent character/scene anchors, and direct pose/angle control per storyboard frame.
inferences: Uses fluid-pixels responsive scaling for multi-column storyboard strips.

platforms.name: NovelAI
observedFacts: Exposes /stories and /image workspaces alongside /user/subscription, /user/data, /user/inventory, and /consume.
Deep navy surface (#0e0f21 / #13152c) paired with warm parchment cream (#f5f3c2) and orchid accents (#DCA7D7).
inferences: Couples narrative lorebook memory (/stories) with tag-weighted anime image synthesis (/image).
unknowns: Anlas credit consumption formula per Vibe Transfer reference image.

platforms.name: Mootion
observedFacts: Provides prompt-to-story, story-to-storyboard, and 3D motion/video sequence generation workflows.
inferences: Targets multi-aspect ratio animatics (9:16 vertical shortform and 16:9 horizontal).
unknowns: Internal timeline export formats inside studio.mootion.com.

platforms.name: SkyReels
observedFacts: Exposes /createVideo and /dev/api-keys routes with dark cinema UI (#1a1a1a) and cinema-gold accent (#FFCF00).
inferences: Focused on vertical micro-drama and webtoon-to-reel episode generation with developer API access.

platforms.name: Frameo AI
observedFacts: Exposes 29 routes including /ai-storyboard-generator, /script-to-video, /story-to-video, /ai-animation-generator, /ai-voice-generator, /creative-partner, and /use-veo3.
Implements an interactive spotlight/cone CSS lighting shader system (--cursor-angle: 45deg, --cone-spread: 25, --glow-a/b/c).
inferences: Integrates multi-model video/storyboard backends (including Veo3) under a unified storyboard-to-video director UI.
unknowns: Per-shot Veo3 token billing inside authenticated workspace.

platforms.name: NAVER WEBTOON SHAPER (셰이퍼)
observedFacts: Highlights 4 core pillars: 1. 프리셋으로 손쉽게 시작 (face/hair/outfit/pose presets), 2. 모델에 직접 그리기 (3D surface direct drawing), 3. AI 기반 편의 기능 (AI reference preset recommendation & webcam/image pose capture), 4. 창작자 편의 기능 (transparent PNG & layered PSD export).
inferences: Bridges 3D character turnaround consistency with 2D webtoon PSD layer pipelines.
unknowns: Internal Unity/Unreal shader graph inside the desktop Windows/macOS binary.

platforms.name: Posemaniacs
observedFacts: Exposes 12 routes including /poses, /tools, /faces, /generated-photos, /pose-of-the-day, /learn, /articles, /courses, and /submissions.
Provides interactive 3D muscle/ecorche camera orbiting, focal length switching, and hand/expression reference tools.
inferences: Combines 3D WebGL anatomy meshes with AI-generated photo reference overlays (/generated-photos).
unknowns: Asset compression format for individual ecorche glTF/DRC bundles.

platforms.name: LlamaGen AI
observedFacts: Exposes routes /new/ai-comic-strips, /agents, /draw, /workflows, /story, /features, and /customer-stories.
inferences: Uses multi-agent workflow orchestration (/agents, /workflows) to maintain character consistency across comic strips.
unknowns: Internal agent graph execution engine behind /workflows.

platforms.name: Dashtoon Studio
observedFacts: Exposes routes /comics, /create, /api/v2/ai-apps/photo-to-comic, /api/v2/ai-apps/photo-to-comic/poll, and /api/v2/ai-apps/user-images.
inferences: Uses asynchronous polling (/api/v2/ai-apps/photo-to-comic/poll) for GPU image-to-comic batch conversion.

platforms.name: LTX Studio (Lightricks)
observedFacts: Provides holistic script-to-shot storyboard generation, camera trajectory presets, and multi-character casting consistency.
inferences: Couples LTX-Video diffusion keyframes with deterministic timeline editing.
unknowns: Authenticated compute unit pricing per second of rendered video.

platforms.name: Boords AI Storyboard
observedFacts: Warm espresso-dark surface (#120e0b / #211c19) with magenta (#FF2D8D) and terracotta (#D97757) accents for storyboard frame timing and animatic voiceover syncing.
inferences: Focuses on pre-production frame pacing and client review links before final rendering.

platforms.name: Magic Poser
observedFacts: Defines explicit CSS variables --mp-dark-blue (#00B7FD), --mp-dark-navy (#24262D), --mp-dark (#12121C) for its 3D multi-character posing, perspective camera, and directional studio lighting.
inferences: Uses inverse kinematics (IK) joint pinning so dragging one limb naturally balances the torso.
unknowns: Pose Cloud community asset binary serialization format.

platforms.name: PoseMy.Art
observedFacts: Zero-install browser 3D posing tool with block meshes, anime/realistic mannequins, and preset animations.
inferences: Bundles Three.js/WebGL scene state locally in browser storage.

platforms.name: Cascadeur
observedFacts: Provides AI-assisted AutoPosing from 6 major joint control points and AutoPhysics ballistic trajectory, center-of-mass, and angular momentum correction.
inferences: Action webtoon creators can extract physically grounded jump/slash keyframes without manual secondary motion curves.
unknowns: Native desktop C++ physics solver weights.

platforms.name: Krea AI
observedFacts: Exposes routes /realtime, /realtime-director, /apps/image/flux-krea, /apps/enhance, /image, and /video.
inferences: Streams low-latency LCM/Flux canvas frames from primitive 3D/2D blocking shapes in /realtime-director.

platforms.name: Leonardo.Ai
observedFacts: Provides Realtime Canvas inpainting/outpainting, Live Sketch, and simultaneous Character Reference + Style Reference + Content Reference guidance.
inferences: Separates identity embedding from style and pose conditioning weights.

platforms.name: GenToon (젠툰)
observedFacts: Exposes explicit reader and commerce CSS variables (--reading-direction: 1, --paper: #f4ebfc, --ink: #40215f, --violet: #7646bd) and routes /view, /supporters, /goods/orders, /creator-hub/goods-notices, /community/goods, /creator-hub/earnings, and /achievements.
inferences: Directly couples AI webtoon episode viewing (/view) with creator goods commerce (/goods/orders) and supporter tiers (/supporters).

platforms.name: TooToon (투툰 · Onoma AI)
observedFacts: Exposes 5 dedicated creator studio modules via routes: /fabulator (story/script), /character-studio (character sheet), /visual-studio (storyboard/layout), /artifex (rendering/coloring), and /emporium (asset marketplace), plus /anima/feed/list community.
inferences: Each Latin-named route maps to one stage of the traditional webtoon studio pipeline.

platforms.name: Tooning Plus (투닝 플러스)
observedFacts: Exposes 6 modular character builder routes (/character-make-basic, /character-make-face, /character-make-body, /character-make-hand, /character-make-hair, /character-make-etc), custom upload routes (/etcUpload-make-basic, /etcUpload-make-addOrSet), and /100x.
inferences: Decomposes 2D webtoon characters into 6 swappable rig parts for zero-drift facial/hand expression switching across cuts.

platforms.name: Enkava (엔카바)
observedFacts: Captured live response envelope for domestic subculture/webtoon creator collaboration hub.
inferences: Serves as a specialized asset & commission exchange for webtoon/illustration creators.

platforms.name: Jitter
observedFacts: Dark violet studio (#19171C / #7A40ED) for layered artboard motion presets and 4K/Lottie export.
inferences: Ideal for animating separated webtoon PSD layers into promotional movingtoon reels.

platforms.name: Lumiere Graphics
observedFacts: Browser-native real-time shader suite providing Kuwahara painterly filtering, film halation, glare, and CRT/dither effects.
inferences: Allows webtoon artists to convert 3D renders into painterly background plates without AI hallucination.

platforms.name: Graphite Editor
observedFacts: Open-source Rust/WASM non-destructive procedural node graph + layer compositor.
inferences: Every vector stroke and raster filter remains editable as a DAG node.
unknowns: WGPU vs WebGL2 backend selection heuristics.

platforms.name: PixiEditor
observedFacts: Exposes routes /docs, /extensions, /colorpicker, /download, and /blog/2025/12/10/21-beta with dark slate (#111214 / #15171a) and amber gold (#F3C31A) UI tokens.
inferences: Unifies procedural node graphs, vector/pixel layers, and frame-by-frame animation in a single document model.

platforms.name: Spline 3D & Hana
observedFacts: Exposes routes /3d-design, /hana, /ai-generate, /ai-style-transfer, and /mcp.
inferences: Combines interactive 3D scene authoring (/3d-design), 2D/3D reactive canvas (/hana), AI style transfer (/ai-style-transfer), and MCP agent control (/mcp).

platforms.name: Rive
observedFacts: Provides skeletal bone + mesh deformation rigging driven by real-time State Machines in ultra-dark UI (#070708 / #0d0d0f) with electric blue (#0099FF) and coral red (#FF483C).
inferences: Enables scroll-position-bound interactive webtoon cuts that deform and animate at 60fps.

platforms.name: MediBang Paint
observedFacts: Specializes in knife-tool comic panel slicing, cloud screentone/font libraries, and multi-device project synchronization.
inferences: Prioritizes lightweight raster/halftone memory footprint for tablet/mobile comic artists.

platforms.name: ibisPaint
observedFacts: Features stroke-by-stroke timelapse recording, Anime Background/Manga Background photo filters, and radial/symmetry rulers.
inferences: Stores drawing history as deterministic command logs for instant timelapse video rendering.

platforms.name: Clip Studio Paint
observedFacts: Industry standard featuring vector intersection eraser, reference-layer close-and-fill, 3D drawing figures, Shading Assist, and vertical webtoon mobile preview area.
inferences: Combines vector centerline graphs with reference-layer flood fill for high-speed webtoon flatting.

platforms.name: ACON3D (에이콘3D)
observedFacts: Global #1 webtoon 3D background/prop marketplace supporting SketchUp (.skp), Blender (.blend), and Snaptoon (.stf) formats.
inferences: Standardizes genre-tagged 3D sets (palace, academy, dungeon, modern office) for rapid camera placement.

platforms.name: WEBTOON CANVAS
observedFacts: Global vertical webtoon publishing platform enforcing 800×1280px slice geometry, 20MB episode payload caps, and series/episode thumbnail specs.
inferences: Acts as the downstream distribution target for all webtoon creation studios.
